title: The Jack of Spades
start: Talk to Ali Mirza in the Al Kharid palace.

rewards.t: Access to the Menaphos reputation system
Talk to Assistant Librarian Subotai to receive the Menaphos journal. After obtaining the journal, the Jewels of the Elid, Cats of Menaphos, and Insects of the Desert can be collected.

steps.t: Talk to Emir Ali Mirza in Al Kharid palace to begin the quest. [Chat: 1 Talk about Jack of Spades. › Accept › 1 Yes.]
p: The Pharaoh and Ambassador Jabari discuss your trip to Menaphos.

steps.t: Go upstairs. Talk to Osman. [Chat: 5 No more questions.]

From the same floor, climb the central north or northwest staircase to the roof and talk to Grand Vizier Hassan. The steps are built into the wall and may be difficult to notice at a glance. Look south west of the fountain. [Chat: 1 I know all I need - let's go!]
Dismiss any follower and unequip the item in your main and off-hand slots. Talk to Grand Vizier Hassan. [Chat: 1 Yes, let's go!]
Talk to Hassan while on the carpet to teleport to Menaphos. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Follow Hassan into the city.
Talk to Hassan. [Chat: 1 Talk about Jack of Spades.] Make sure you finish all dialogue. There are (brief) pauses between dialogue after talking to each person below.
Head north east to the shifting tombs entrance in the centre of the market square.
Choose the Travel Ports District option on the tombs to go to the Port district.
Talk to 'Admiral' Wadud (Ports) in The Golden Scarab Inn just north.
p: The Jack of Spades appears and robs Wadud.

steps.t: Choose the Travel Imperial District option on the tombs to the Imperial district. (This is a good time to activate the Menaphos Lodestone just East of you.)
Speak to Commander Akhomet (Imperial) in front of the entrance to the Great Pyramid just west. Make sure you finish the dialogue, as there is a pause as the Jack of Spades appears.
Choose the Travel Worker District option on the tombs to the Worker district.
Talk to Batal (Worker) next to the fire pit. Make sure you finish the dialogue, as there is a pause as the Jack of Spades appears.
Enter the shifting tombs to go inside.
Ensure you have 4 backpack spaces.
Talk to the Jack of Spades. [Chat: 3 Why steal from people? › 4 I've heard enough.]
Exit the shifting tombs to any district.
Referencing above locations, return the four stolen items to their respective districts. It is recommended to do the Merchant district last as Hassan is there.
p: The Jack is revealed to be Ozan.

steps.t: Return to Hassan in the Merchant district. [Chat: 1 Talk about Jack of Spades.]
Quest complete!
Before leaving the city, feel free to activate the Menaphos lodestone if you didn't do it in the previous steps.
